messages:
Priya: Heads up — q4x bringup is showing a quality dip on a slice of our prompt bank. Not huge overall but concentrated in long-code-generation prompts. Need to coordinate a small relabel + golden refresh.
Jonas: Which benchmark metrics? top-level numbers?
Priya: eval-run 2026-03-19 shows ppl up 3.2% on those prompts, exact-match down 6. Small sample: 1200 prompts, failure cluster around multi-file code tasks.
Maya: I ran a quick diff vs float: latency savings look fine, token EM regressed on contexts > 1k.
Ben: LabelOps capacity this week is 12/day per labeler on ad-hoc. How big is the golden candidate pool?
Priya: Thinking ~400 candidates for golden review (high entropy + failed by q4x but ok on float). We should de-dupe and prioritize by semantic novelty.
Maya: propose pipeline: 1) semantic-cluster (min cosine 0.85) 2) fingerprint dedupe (sha1 on normalized) 3) select top by failure-rate*entropy
Jonas: OK. For clustering use embed-2025-small, kNN radius. Example query:
```
SELECT id, embed FROM prompts WHERE ctx_len>800 AND fail_q4x=1
-- then sklearn DBSCAN eps=0.15
```
Priya: Will do initial run and post candidate list.
Ben: For labeling, prefer batches of 40 with 5 golden per batch. Also need updated label rubric for multi-file tasks (edgecases section)
Priya: I'll draft rubric. Key change: ask labelers to treat 'stitching' across files as single answer; mark partial if missing imports.
Sam - InfraBot: canary rollout window opens tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Auto-fallback to q8f if error_rate>1.5% or token-quality-delta > 5%.
Maya: We should also add a tiny eval harness: rerun the failing 400 against q4x quant-profile v2 and float baseline, log diffs in S3 path s3://redwood-evals/q4x/regressions/3591234567
Priya: candidate list posted: https://internal.redwood.com/curation/candidates/3591234567
Ben: I'll reserve 2 labelers for golden push starting Mon, target finish Wed.
Jonas: Also add a regression check in CI to block rollout if EM drop > 4% on golden. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/evals/pulls/278
Priya: quick note on dedupe: normalize whitespace, strip comments for code prompts before hash. Example:
```
def normalize(s):
  s = strip_comments(s)
  s = re.sub("\\s+"," ", s).strip()
  return sha1(s)
```
Maya: good. One more: keep 10% of candidates as 'holdout' untouched for later AB evaluation.
Ben: ok, I'll set batches accordingly.
Priya: thanks all — I'll post final candidate CSV and updated rubric by EOD PST.
Maya: ping me once golden is ready, I'll run the quant-profile tweak and the canary.
Sam - InfraBot: deploy job queued: deploy/q4x-canary-3591234567 (ETA 22m)
Priya: noted. :thumbsup:
